status: Draft - based on ASD-STE100 Issue 9. To be reviewed by the Linguistic Team.
intro: Parts of Speech (POS) are the word classes of English: noun, verb, adjective and so on. STE approves each word for ONE part of speech (Rule 1.2), so you must know the part of speech to use a word correctly. The position of a word in the sentence shows its part of speech. Example: "Test" is an approved noun but not an approved verb.

entries.name: Noun
entries.definition: A word that names a thing, a place, a person or an idea.
entries.ste_tip: Usually follows "the", "a" or "an". A noun is not a verb: write "Do a test of the system", not "Test the system" (Rule 1.2, 3.7).
entries.ste: Do the leak test of the system.

entries.name: Verb
entries.definition: A word that shows an action or a state.
entries.ste_tip: Use an approved verb to show an action, not a noun (Rule 3.7). In a step, start with the verb: "Remove the bolt."
entries.ste: Clean the inner surface of the container.
entries.non_ste: Perform cleaning of the inner surface.

entries.name: Adjective
entries.definition: A word that tells you more about a noun (what kind, which one).
entries.ste_tip: Comes before a noun or after "is/are". "Dim" is an approved adjective but not an approved verb.

entries.name: Adverb
entries.definition: A word that tells you more about a verb, an adjective or another adverb (how, when, where).
entries.ste_tip: Use the approved adverb in the dictionary. Do not use an adverb to replace a precise value.

entries.name: Preposition
entries.definition: A word that links a noun or pronoun to another word and shows place, time or direction.
entries.ste_tip: Approved prepositions are limited. Do not use phrasal verbs (verb + preposition) unless they are in the dictionary (Rule 9.3).
entries.ste: Put the cover on the unit.

entries.name: Conjunction
entries.definition: A word that joins words, groups of words or sentences (and, or, but, if).
entries.ste_tip: Use only the approved conjunctions. Do not join two long ideas in one sentence - make two sentences.
entries.ste: Open the door and remove the cover.

entries.name: Article
entries.definition: A word that comes before a noun (a, an, the).
entries.ste_tip: Use an article to make the noun clear. Use "the" for a specific item.

entries.name: Pronoun
entries.definition: A word used in place of a noun (it, they, this).
entries.ste_tip: Make sure it is clear which noun the pronoun replaces. If it is not clear, repeat the noun.

entries.name: Technical noun / technical verb
entries.definition: A noun or verb for a product, a process or a subject field that is not in the dictionary. Written by the author, not approved by the dictionary.
entries.ste_tip: Allowed under Rules 1.5 and 1.6 if it follows the category rules. In STELOS, add it to the shared library under a category.
